---
title: "Patch supplementary figures"
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

## Overview

This document patches supplementary figures for the manuscript by removing titles/subtitles and adjusting formatting for consistency. Includes ADNI/AIBL scatter plots and CSF biomarker comparisons.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

# Additional packages (tidyverse, here, glue loaded via .Rprofile)
pacman::p_load(ggtext, ragg, install = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png")

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load Plot Objects

Load pre-generated plot objects from validation and DMP analyses.

```{r}
#| label: load-plots

# Supplementary Fig 1: ADNI/AIBL scatter
fig_adni_aibl <- read_rds(
 here("validation/output/fig_validation_ADNI_AIBL_scatter_three_transitions.rds")
)

# Supplementary Fig 2: CSF pTau scatter
fig_csf_ptau <- read_rds(
 here("validation/output/fig_validation_CSF_pTau_CN_scatter_three_transitions.rds")
)

# Supplementary Fig 3: CSF Total Tau scatter
fig_csf_total_tau <- read_rds(
 here("validation/output/fig_validation_CSF_total_Tau_CN_scatter_three_transitions.rds")
)
```

## Patch Supplementary Fig 1 (ADNI/AIBL)

Remove title and subtitle only.

```{r}
#| label: patch-fig1

fig_adni_aibl_patched <- fig_adni_aibl +
 labs(
   title = NULL,
   subtitle = NULL
 ) +
 theme(
   strip.text.x = element_textbox_simple(size = 9, halign = 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(10, 4, 4, 4)),
   strip.text.y = element_textbox_simple(size = 8, halign = 0.5, orientation = "right-rotated", lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(4, 10, 4, 4))
 )
fig_adni_aibl_patched <- rescale_layer_params(fig_adni_aibl_patched, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)
```

## Patch Supplementary Fig 2 (CSF pTau)

Update y-axis title and remove title/subtitle.

```{r}
#| label: patch-fig2

fig_csf_ptau_patched <- fig_csf_ptau +
 labs(
   y = "Effect size of CSF pTau (CN) <br> <span style='font-size:9pt; color:#333333'>(N<sub>Subjects</sub> = 123)</span>",
   title = NULL,
   subtitle = NULL
 ) +
 theme(
   strip.text.x = element_textbox_simple(size = 9, halign = 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(10, 4, 4, 4)),
   strip.text.y = element_textbox_simple(size = 8, halign = 0.5, orientation = "right-rotated", lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(4, 10, 4, 4))
 )
fig_csf_ptau_patched <- rescale_layer_params(fig_csf_ptau_patched, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)
```

## Patch Supplementary Fig 3 (CSF Total Tau)

Update y-axis title and remove title/subtitle.

```{r}
#| label: patch-fig3

fig_csf_total_tau_patched <- fig_csf_total_tau +
 labs(
   y = "Effect size of CSF Total Tau (CN) <br> <span style='font-size:9pt; color:#333333'>(N<sub>Subjects</sub> = 123)</span>",
   title = NULL,
   subtitle = NULL
 ) +
 theme(
   strip.text.x = element_textbox_simple(size = 9, halign = 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(10, 4, 4, 4)),
   strip.text.y = element_textbox_simple(size = 8, halign = 0.5, orientation = "right-rotated", lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(4, 10, 4, 4))
 )
fig_csf_total_tau_patched <- rescale_layer_params(fig_csf_total_tau_patched, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)
```

## Save Patched Figures

Export all patched supplementary figures as high-resolution PNG files.

```{r}
#| label: save-figures

fs::dir_create(here("validation/patch_figures/output"))

# Save Supplementary Fig 1
ggsave(
 here("validation/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_1_ADNI_AIBL_scatter.png"),
 fig_adni_aibl_patched,
 width = 6.5,
 height = 8.1,
 dpi = 600,
 bg = "white",
 device = ragg::agg_png
)

# Save Supplementary Fig 2
ggsave(
 here("validation/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_2_CSF_pTau_scatter.png"),
 fig_csf_ptau_patched,
 width = 6.5,
 height = 8.1,
 dpi = 600,
 bg = "white",
 device = ragg::agg_png
)

# Save Supplementary Fig 3
ggsave(
 here("validation/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_3_CSF_total_Tau_scatter.png"),
 fig_csf_total_tau_patched,
 width = 6.5,
 height = 8.1,
 dpi = 600,
 bg = "white",
 device = ragg::agg_png
)

message("Patched supplementary figures saved to validation/patch_figures/output/")
```

## Verify Output

List all output files with their sizes and modification times.

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(here("validation/patch_figures/output"), glob = "*.png")
file_info <- fs::file_info(output_files)
file_info |>
 select(path, size, modification_time) |>
 mutate(path = basename(path))
```
